owner_session_id.description: Session currently working this feature. Advisory, not a mutex: it lets a second session see the collision instead of discovering it in the git log. Cleared on release.

owner_heartbeat_ts.description: When the owner was last seen. A claim older than the staleness window is treated as abandoned, so a crashed session cannot own a feature permanently.

archreview.description: Phase 6a-prime outcome. SKIPPED_NO_PANE records that no reviewer pane resolved; it now BLOCKS Phase 7 - a headless `exec agy` review satisfies the gate. SKIPPED_OPERATOR_OVERRIDE is the deliberate operator escape when no reviewer exists at all; it closes the feature but surfaces as a warning. Neither is ever equivalent to READY_TO_MERGE, and both must surface in the Phase 7 report.

substrate.description: Dispatch environment for this run, written at Phase-5 start from `hmad-dispatch env` via `--set substrate=…`. OPTIONAL and additive: records written before the field existed have no such key and stay valid (`required` is unchanged), so this is not a version break. `h_mad_telemetry.py record` copies it onto the run row so a log states which environment a feature dispatched under.

codex_status.description: Optional Codex availability declaration; absent/null means available. Phase-5 authoring is resolved by h_mad_tdd_judge.py implementer using both Codex and agy availability. Codex being out alone does not permit Claude to author: fallback_agent is read only when both peers are out. The orchestrator separately uses unavailable/exhausted to route the second audit surface; that routing is prose-enforced by SKILL.md, not read automatically by the audit script. Set back to available when Codex returns.

fallback_agent.description: Who covers Phase-5 authoring when both peers are out. The field is read only when codex is out and agy is out too: each peer is out when its HMAD_CODEX_UNAVAILABLE/HMAD_AGY_UNAVAILABLE flag is non-empty, its codex_status/agy_status is unavailable|exhausted, or its CLI is not on PATH. Absent, null and 'claude' are equivalent: Claude covers, test-first. HMAD_CODEX_UNAVAILABLE does not override 'grok'; a one-off Claude escape needs --set fallback_agent=claude. Audit-leg routing to grok (audit-cycle --surfaces agy,grok) is prose-enforced by SKILL.md, and no script reads this field for it.

implementer.description: Optional preferred Phase-5 implementer; absent/null uses the resolver's default order.

agy_status.description: Optional agy availability declaration; absent/null means available.

implementer_switch.description: Last implementer switch; ts is checked semantically before either schema tier.

implementation_authors.description: Accepted implementation dispatch log, preserving duplicates and acceptance order.
